ordering: all regular-file fsync calls first; then nested directory fsync bottom-up; borrowed root last
positive_calls: recording wrappers call actual os.fsync; identities obtained from actual fstat
execution: existing pinned nix develop --offline; uv run --offline --no-sync; no dependency or gate modifications
raw_log_handling: scratch harness diagnostics are not public/private-tree provenance; do not publish traceback locals or raw fixture paths
tested_faults: owner UID synthetic on actual root fstat branch; no foreign file mutation
exact private modes and special bits
actual symlink and FIFO refusal before opening
inode substitutions before open and after fsync for file and directory
actual parent directory rename and replacement sentinel after root FD opened; unrelated cwd
file/nested-directory/root fsync refusal selected by actual dev/inode
OSError EINVAL unsupported sync, KeyboardInterrupt and fixture-owned BaseException subclass
double cleanup faults after actual FD release preserve identity and origin frame
before-release cleanup faults attempted independently once; fixture releases retained kernel handles
scandir/open/stat failures preserve origin and sanitize OSError
directory iteration and scan-close double fault after actual release
actual proc-self-fd baseline recovery and borrowed root retention

primary_authorities.rule: file fsync does not synchronize enclosing directory entries; directory needs its own fsync
